text:
rachel: heads-up: ap-south-1 keystore HSM-proxy started returning 429s to decrypt calls, warm-pool nodes stuck onboarding (0/6 joined) :alarm_clock:
ben: any recent deploys or config changes to the HSM proxy / ALB?
kevin: quick check: ALB target group for hsm-proxy had new slow-start and connection-draining TTL from yesterday's perf tweak. seems we pushed sticky session + reduced max_conn per target.
anne: logs from node agent (sanitized):
```
2026-03-21T02:11:03Z hsm-proxy: 429 throttle from backend, tokenbucket empty
2026-03-21T02:11:03Z node-agent: decrypt failed: 429
2026-03-21T02:11:04Z warm-pool: fail join attempt 1/6
```
ops-bot: @channel alert: hsm-proxy-429-rate > 8% in ap-south-1, warm-pool join-rate <20%
ben: interestingly the error surfaces as 429, not 503/504. could be rate-limiter on HSM side or ALB per-target conn limit.
kevin: triage: (1) check HSM-proxy concurrency (2) review ALB target max_conn and slow-start (3) see if TLS handshake CPU is causing slow accepts.
sana: tagging security: do we need any approvals to scale proxies? any compliance concerns for HSM throughput?
kevin: scaling HSM-proxy is within infra scope; no key material changes. will still add a short ad-hoc approval to keep audit trail.
rachel: short-term mitigation options?
ben: we can (A) bump HSM-proxy replica count in the region (fast but increases cost), (B) temporarily relax ALB connection limits / disable slow-start for this TG, (C) add client-side jittered retries in the agent. prefer (B)+C for minimal infra cost.
kevin: I started a canary: increased hsm-proxy target group max_conn for AZ-b at 02:23 UTC and disabled slow-start for that TG.
ops-bot: infra-bot deploy: 02:24 -> AZ-b config applied, AZ-a and AZ-c pending due to deployment pipeline lock. connectivity check: proxy health green in AZ-b.
anne: after AZ-b change we saw onboarding 2/6 -> 4/6 within 6 minutes. good signal.
ben: note: client retry patch is low-risk; I'll open a tiny PR to add exponential backoff with capped retries and jitter.
kevin: request security approval for a 48-hr regional scale increase to hsm-proxy replicas and temporary ALB rule tweak while we roll a permanent fix. tagging @sana.
sana: approved for 48h scoped to ap-south-1 hsm-proxy TG only. require changelog and rollback script.
kevin: PR created: https://internal/prs/infra/4321 - includes changelog and rollback steps. also adding runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/hsm-proxy-throttle-mitigation
rachel: alternative for audit: increase local audit buffer and ship backlog asynchronously. cost estimate: additional S3/ingest ~$200/day if we buffer for 48h at peak.
anne: prefer fixing the root cause. buffering will mask lossiness and complicate compliance checks.
ben: FYI the client retry PR will be minimal and can be rolled out as a canary to warm-pool agents in region first.
kevin: AZ-a and AZ-c updates done at 02:38 UTC; global metrics show hsm-proxy 429 rate dropping to baseline. warm-pool join 6/6 at 02:45.
ops-bot: metrics: 02:46 -> hsm-proxy-429-rate 0.9%, warm-pool joins 100%, audit-ingest backlog drained.
anne: running validation suite for audit completeness and key handshake integrity; will report within 20m.
ben: follow-ups: (1) revert the slow-start tweak repo change and codify ALB limits in infra docs; (2) add HSM-proxy canary that simulates concurrent decrypts pre-merge; (3) cost/ops note for wider region impacts.
sana: will schedule a postmortem sync with security + infra tomorrow. please include audit timeline and the PR link.
anne: validation completed: audit sampling intact, no missing decrypt events, warm-pool stable. resolving thread. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
